    AI Overview
    No. 1 seed South Carolina defeated No. 3 TCU 78-52 on March 30, 2026, to advance to their sixth consecutive Final Four. Led by Joyce Edwards' 24 points and 12 rebounds, the Gamecocks broke open a close game with a dominant 29-11 fourth-quarter surge. South Carolina faces UConn in the Final Four. 
    Key Game Details 
    • Result: South Carolina 78, TCU 52.
    • Top Performers (SC): Joyce Edwards (24 pts, 12 reb), Agot Makeer (18 pts).
    • Top Performers (TCU): Olivia Miles (18 pts, 6 ast).
    • Game Impact: South Carolina (35-3) advances to the 2026 Final Four in Phoenix to play UConn on April 3.
    • Tournament Run: The Gamecocks continued their dominant tournament run, winning their Elite Eight matchup by 26 points. 
    Game Summary
    South Carolina led 49-41 going into the fourth quarter before pulling away from the Horned Frogs (32-6). TCU's offense struggled to keep pace, with Key addition Marta Suarez held to 9 points on 4-for-17 shooting. The Gamecocks, led by coach Dawn Staley, maintained their defensive intensity, limiting TCU to 52 points.
